_comment: Facts + choices for scripts/standardize_vehicle.py: POLYGON QuadBike SM_Veh_QuadBike_01 -> vehicles.json `quad`. Positions in the SOURCE frame (faces +Z; measured, docs/research/vehicle-models-facts.md). The handlebar mesh has a stem component (140 tris, a tilted block) whose principal axis, by SVD of its vertices, is (0, 0.7086, -0.7056) through its centre (0, 1.031, 0.374): the steering column, leaned back 45 deg; the bars turn about it (`steer_bars`), the front wheels steer about Y. The pack put the front-left wheel 0.035 m inboard of its pair (pivot x 0.298, the others 0.333): `dx` moves it out. Rider: hips on the saddle (top y 0.86..0.92 over z -0.5..0.1), feet = saddle - 0.45 (the seated figure is the crouch stance); the saddle is 0.6 m long, one rider.
name: Quad bike (standardized SM_Veh_QuadBike_01)
